title: Ochratoxin A drives hepatocellular carcinoma progression via GRPR-mediated activation of PLCbeta/IP3R/Ca(2)(+) and RPS15A/p53 pathways by regulating cancer cell fate.
authors: Yang, Yan-Qi; Li, Wen-Xing; Zhao, Xin-Liang; Yang, Yang; Liu, Zhi-Gang; Cheng, Shao-Li; Zhou, Kai; Diao, Dong-Mei; Ge, Pan; Lv, Mo-Qi; Sun, Ying; Kang, Jia-Ying; Sun, Rui-Fang; Zhou, Dang-Xia; Gao, Jun-Hong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究赭曲霉毒素A通过GRPR受体激活信号通路促进肝癌进展，虽含分子对接但核心是受体-小分子互作与细胞命运调控，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Ochratoxin A (OTA), a group 2B human carcinogen, has been implicated in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), yet its precise molecular mechanisms remain elusive. In this study, we investigated the oncogenic role of OTA using both in vitro (Huh7 and Hep-3B cell lines) and in vivo (C57BL/6 mouse models) approaches. Molecular docking, surface plasmon resonance, co-immunoprecipitation coupled with mass spectrometry (Co-IP/MS), and functional rescue experiments were employed to elucidate the underlying pathways. Our results demonstrated that OTA exposure (50 nM) significantly promoted HCC cell proliferation, migration, and invasion. Molecular docking combined with surface plasmon resonance revealed a high-affinity binding interaction between OTA and the gastrin-releasing peptide receptor (GRPR), which was subsequently validated by the observed upregulation of GRPR expression upon OTA treatment. We further demonstrated that OTA activates the canonical GRPR downstream pathway, PLCbeta/IP3R/Ca(2 +) , leading to increased intracellular calcium levels. Furthermore, Co-IP/MS identified ribosomal protein S15A (RPS15A) as a novel GRPR-interacting protein. RPS15A overexpression facilitated HCC progression by recruiting MDM2 to accelerate the degradation of p53, thereby upregulating the SLC7A11/GPX4 axis-a key regulator of ferroptosis. Crucially, GRPR knockdown effectively attenuated OTA-induced tumor growth both in vitro and in vivo. Collectively, our findings reveal a novel mechanism whereby OTA promotes HCC progression by binding to GRPR and activating both the PLCbeta/IP3R/Ca(2+) signaling cascade and the RPS15A/p53/SLC7A11/GPX4 axis, suggesting that targeting GRPR may represent a promising therapeutic strategy for OTA-associated HCC.
abstract_zh: 赭曲霉毒素A（OTA）是一种2B类人类致癌物，与肝细胞癌（HCC）相关，但其精确的分子机制仍不明确。在本研究中，我们利用体外（Huh7和Hep-3B细胞系）和体内（C57BL/6小鼠模型）方法探讨了OTA的致癌作用。采用分子对接、表面等离子体共振、免疫共沉淀结合质谱（Co-IP/MS）以及功能拯救实验来阐明潜在通路。我们的结果表明，OTA暴露（50 nM）显著促进HCC细胞增殖、迁移和侵袭。分子对接结合表面等离子体共振揭示了OTA与胃泌素释放肽受体（GRPR）之间的高亲和力结合相互作用，随后通过观察OTA处理后GRPR表达上调得到验证。我们进一步证明，OTA激活经典的GRPR下游通路PLCbeta/IP3R/Ca(2+)，导致细胞内钙水平升高。此外，Co-IP/MS鉴定出核糖体蛋白S15A（RPS15A）为一种新的GRPR相互作用蛋白。RPS15A过表达通过招募MDM2加速p53降解，从而上调SLC7A11/GPX4轴（铁死亡的关键调节因子），促进HCC进展。至关重要的是，GRPR敲低有效减弱了OTA诱导的体外和体内肿瘤生长。总体而言，我们的发现揭示了一种新机制，即OTA通过结合GRPR并激活PLCbeta/IP3R/Ca(2+)信号级联和RPS15A/p53/SLC7A11/GPX4轴促进HCC进展，提示靶向GRPR可能代表一种有前景的OTA相关HCC治疗策略。
